applicant_profile: Pakistani nationals applying for a Canadian Study Permit (regular stream; SDS closed Nov 2024).
framing_disclaimer: Measures DOCUMENTED READINESS and RISK EXPOSURE. Does NOT predict the officer's decision and is not legal/immigration advice. Canada has NO country 'evidence level' system. Verify current figures at canada.ca before applying.

config.quebec_note: Quebec uses its own (much higher) thresholds from 2026-01-01 and requires a CAQ; handled separately.
config.evidence_level_system: NONE — Canada does not use Australia's SSVF country evidence levels. Do not display one.
config.note: Outside-Quebec single living-cost requirement = CAD 22,895 from 2025-09-01 (LICO-indexed, reviewed annually). Confirm the live figure on the IRCC page on the day of application; IRCC has signalled a move toward a dynamic cost-of-living model.

score_bands.label: Strong Readiness
score_bands.description: Documented file is well-prepared with low visible risk. NOT a prediction or guarantee of approval — bona-fide assessment is officer-dependent. Re-verify figures and submit once minor items are closed.

score_bands.label: Moderate Risk — Improve Before Lodging
score_bands.description: Eligible but with weak points an officer will probe (ties, funds history, study-plan logic). Close flagged items before applying.

score_bands.label: High Refusal Risk
score_bands.description: Serious gaps. Applying now with these gaps unaddressed indicates serious unresolved readiness issues. Resolve all high-risk flags first.

score_bands.label: Critical Refusal Risk
score_bands.description: Mandatory items missing or integrity flags present. Do not apply — critical readiness gaps that are grounds for refusal or a returned application, and misrepresentation can trigger a 5-year A40 bar.

scoring_categories.label: Bona Fide Student & Intent to Leave

tiers.hard_blocker: Any triggered hard blocker forces result 'Critical Refusal Risk'; score skipped. These are legally mandatory items or integrity grounds.
tiers.high_risk_flag: Each triggered high-risk flag deducts impact AND caps the max band: 1-2 flags => cap 'High Refusal Risk'; 3+ => 'Critical Refusal Risk'. Prevents proportional averaging from hiding serious risk.
tiers.soft_warning: Each triggered soft warning deducts impact within the band; does not cap the band.

calculation_logic.step_1: Evaluate hard blockers. If ANY triggers -> 'Critical Refusal Risk'; stop.
calculation_logic.step_2: Per category: category_score = (sum score_impact of PASSING scored questions / sum score_impact of ALL scored questions) x max_points. 'info' questions (trigger_if=never) are routing-only, excluded from pass/fail.
calculation_logic.step_3: total_score = sum of category scores, rounded to nearest integer.
calculation_logic.step_4: Count triggered high-risk flags; apply band cap (1-2 => High; 3+ => Critical).
calculation_logic.step_5: Map total to a band, then final band = worse of score-band and cap-band.
calculation_logic.passing_definition: A question PASSES when the answer satisfies pass_if. Computed financial passes: living funds >= 22895 (+dependants/Quebec); total funds >= living + first-year tuition + transport.
calculation_logic.rounding: Category to 1 decimal; total to nearest integer.

result_payload_template.label: <band label>
result_payload_template.estimated_refusal_concerns: <triggered hard blockers + high-risk flags in plain English>
result_payload_template.recommended_improvements: <soft warnings + how to close each flag>
result_payload_template.priority_action_list: <hard blockers first, then high-risk flags, then soft warnings>
result_payload_template.disclaimer: Readiness assessment, not an approval prediction or legal advice. Verify all figures at canada.ca before applying.

critical_blockers_hard.mapped_rule: Must Be Enrolled at a Designated Learning Institution (DLI)
critical_blockers_hard.message: You cannot apply without an LOA from a DLI. An admission/offer email is not enough — you need the official LOA. Beware agents enrolling you at non-DLI 'colleges'.

critical_blockers_hard.mapped_rule: Must Be Enrolled at a Designated Learning Institution (DLI)
critical_blockers_hard.message: Check the DLI number on the government list yourself. Many Pakistani students are mis-sold into institutions that are not DLIs or have lost PGWP eligibility.

critical_blockers_hard.mapped_rule: Must Be Enrolled at a Designated Learning Institution (DLI)
critical_blockers_hard.message: The DLI number (starts with 'O') is required in the application. It is on your LOA.

critical_blockers_hard.mapped_rule: Letter of Acceptance (LOA) Required — Must Be Uploaded Correctly
critical_blockers_hard.message: An LOA in the wrong field can cause the system not to register it. Follow the document checklist exactly.

critical_blockers_hard.mapped_rule: Letter of Acceptance (LOA) Required — Must Be Uploaded Correctly
critical_blockers_hard.message: Since the LOA-verification system, IRCC checks LOAs directly with institutions. A fake or unverifiable LOA = refusal and a misrepresentation finding.

critical_blockers_hard.mapped_rule: Bona Fide Student — Must Prove Intent to Leave Canada on Expiry
critical_blockers_hard.message: Canada has no 'GS form' like Australia — your study plan/Letter of Explanation IS your case for being a genuine student who will leave on expiry. Weak SOPs and weak home ties are the top Pakistani refusal reasons.

critical_blockers_hard.mapped_rule: Provincial Attestation Letter (PAL) or Territorial Attestation Letter (TAL) Required
critical_blockers_hard.message: Most non-Quebec post-secondary applicants must include a PAL/TAL or the application is returned. It is issued by the province after you have an LOA.

critical_blockers_hard.mapped_rule: Provincial Attestation Letter (PAL) or Territorial Attestation Letter (TAL) Required
critical_blockers_hard.message: The PAL/TAL must be in the initial submission. Sending it later does not fix a returned application.

critical_blockers_hard.mapped_rule: Quebec Applicants Need Certificat d'acceptation du Québec (CAQ)
critical_blockers_hard.message: Quebec study requires a CAQ from the province before/with the federal study permit. No CAQ = cannot proceed for Quebec.

critical_blockers_hard.mapped_rule: Quebec Applicants Need Certificat d'acceptation du Québec (CAQ)
critical_blockers_hard.message: The CAQ must reflect Quebec's attestation/allocation. An incomplete CAQ will not satisfy IRCC.

critical_blockers_hard.mapped_rule: Sufficient Financial Proof Required — Updated Threshold September 2025
critical_blockers_hard.message: Outside Quebec, a single applicant must show CAD 22,895 for living costs (from Sept 2025), separate from tuition and travel. More for dependants; Quebec is higher.

critical_blockers_hard.mapped_rule: Sufficient Financial Proof Required — Updated Threshold September 2025
critical_blockers_hard.message: Total must cover CAD 22,895 living + first-year tuition + ~CAD 1,500 return transport (plus dependants). Funds must be genuine and accessible, not a paper figure.

critical_blockers_hard.mapped_rule: Medical Exam Required for Stays of 6+ Months
critical_blockers_hard.message: An IME is required for 6+ month stays. Pakistani applicants typically need TB screening (chest X-ray).

critical_blockers_hard.mapped_rule: Medical Exam Required for Stays of 6+ Months
critical_blockers_hard.message: Only exams by IRCC panel physicians count. A cheaper local clinic's report is worthless for the permit.

critical_blockers_hard.mapped_rule: All Documents and Statements Must Be Truthful (Misrepresentation Bar)
critical_blockers_hard.message: Misrepresentation (fake bank balances, altered transcripts, hidden refusals) causes refusal AND a 5-year ban under A40. This applies even if an agent did it in your name.

high_risk_flags.mapped_rule: Bona Fide Student — Must Prove Intent to Leave Canada on Expiry
high_risk_flags.message: Officers weigh DOCUMENTABLE ties most: property in your name, a family business, a written return job offer. 'My parents live here' alone is weak.

high_risk_flags.mapped_rule: Bona Fide Student — Must Prove Intent to Leave Canada on Expiry
high_risk_flags.message: Generic 'Canada has good education' reasoning gets refused. Tie the exact program/curriculum to your background and a Pakistan-based career outcome.

high_risk_flags.mapped_rule: Bona Fide Student — Must Prove Intent to Leave Canada on Expiry
high_risk_flags.message: Officers probe whether study is the real purpose. Have a defensible reason tied to program quality/accreditation — not work or immigration.

high_risk_flags.mapped_rule: Bona Fide Student — Must Prove Intent to Leave Canada on Expiry
high_risk_flags.message: A drastic, unexplained downgrade or field-switch (e.g. completed Bachelors then a junior diploma) is a classic refusal trigger and signals non-genuine study.

high_risk_flags.mapped_rule: Educational Consistency and Study-Plan Logic (Bona Fide-linked)
high_risk_flags.message: Provide employment letters, salary slips, freelance/contract proof, or transcripts covering the gap. Unevidenced 'I was preparing/at home' is weak and invites refusal.

high_risk_flags.mapped_rule: Educational Consistency and Study-Plan Logic (Bona Fide-linked)
high_risk_flags.message: Allowed, but a large switch is scrutinised for genuineness. If yes, your Letter of Explanation must connect old and new fields with a credible career story.

high_risk_flags.mapped_rule: Educational Consistency and Study-Plan Logic (Bona Fide-linked)
high_risk_flags.message: Provide HEC-attested degrees and IBCC-attested FSc/Matric where applicable, plus certified English translations. Unverifiable academics are a refusal/misrepresentation risk.

high_risk_flags.mapped_rule: Sufficient Financial Proof Required — Updated Threshold September 2025
high_risk_flags.message: IRCC expects ~4 months of statement history, not a fresh lump sum. A balance that appears suddenly before applying signals arranged funds.

high_risk_flags.mapped_rule: Sufficient Financial Proof Required — Updated Threshold September 2025
high_risk_flags.message: Consistency beats a recent injection. Erratic statements trigger doubts about whether funds are genuinely yours/accessible.

high_risk_flags.mapped_rule: Sufficient Financial Proof Required — Updated Threshold September 2025
high_risk_flags.message: The core legitimacy test. Each major deposit needs proof: registered sale deed for property, FBR-declared salary, sanctioned loan letter, or a notarised gift affidavit from a traceable giver.

high_risk_flags.mapped_rule: Sufficient Financial Proof Required — Updated Threshold September 2025
high_risk_flags.message: A sponsor showing large funds but no FBR tax history is a major red flag — it implies undeclared/untraceable income. Declared income should plausibly support the amount.
Prior refusals are visible and heavily weighed. A refusal is survivable IF disclosed and explained — concealment is fatal and is misrepresentation.
An asylum history strongly conflicts with 'temporary student who will leave' and must be addressed candidly, ideally with legal advice.

Some agents inflate bank balances, fake experience letters, or alter transcripts. If an agent fabricated anything, YOU face refusal AND a 5-year misrepresentation ban (A40). Verify every line yourself.

soft_warnings.mapped_rule: Bona Fide Student — Must Prove Intent to Leave Canada on Expiry
soft_warnings.message: Attach what you can: property papers, family business registration, a conditional return offer. Dual intent is allowed, but you must still show you would leave if not granted PR.

soft_warnings.mapped_rule: Sufficient Financial Proof Required — Updated Threshold September 2025
soft_warnings.message: Immediate-family sponsorship is expected and trusted. Distant relatives or 'family friends' as sponsors raise scrutiny and need a strong relationship + funds explanation.

soft_warnings.mapped_rule: Sufficient Financial Proof Required — Updated Threshold September 2025
soft_warnings.message: Property-sale funding is fine if the deed is registered and proceeds entered the account via banking channel — not cash.

soft_warnings.mapped_rule: Sufficient Financial Proof Required — Updated Threshold September 2025
soft_warnings.message: Education loans are accepted with a formal sanction letter from a recognised institution. Informal/family loans carry less weight.

soft_warnings.mapped_rule: Sufficient Financial Proof Required — Updated Threshold September 2025
soft_warnings.message: Return travel cost must be covered on top of living + tuition.

soft_warnings.mapped_rule: Guaranteed Investment Certificate (GIC) Still Accepted as Financial Evidence
soft_warnings.message: Only GICs from participating institutions are recognised. Verify before buying.

soft_warnings.mapped_rule: Guaranteed Investment Certificate (GIC) Still Accepted as Financial Evidence
soft_warnings.message: A GIC covers part of living costs; you must still evidence tuition payment and transport separately.

soft_warnings.mapped_rule: Biometrics Required for Most Applicants Aged 14–79
soft_warnings.message: Biometrics (CAD ~85) apply to most applicants aged 14–79. Pay it and book at a VAC in Pakistan.

soft_warnings.mapped_rule: Biometrics Required for Most Applicants Aged 14–79
soft_warnings.message: Complete biometrics at a VAC after receiving the Biometrics Instruction Letter (BIL). Delays here slow processing.
SDS ended 8 Nov 2024. There is no fast GIC+IELTS shortcut now — everyone uses the regular study permit stream.

soft_warnings.mapped_rule: Changing Schools Requires a New Study Permit (From November 8, 2024)
soft_warnings.message: Switching DLI without a new permit breaches your conditions. Plan your program carefully before applying.

soft_warnings.mapped_rule: Off-Campus Work Limited to 24 Hours Per Week
soft_warnings.message: Off-campus work is only allowed after studies begin, not on arrival.

soft_warnings.mapped_rule: Off-Campus Work Limited to 24 Hours Per Week
soft_warnings.message: Off-campus work is capped at 24 hrs/week while classes are in session (full-time during scheduled breaks). Over-working breaches your permit.
Stopping studies beyond 150 days without authorisation can lead to loss of status.

soft_warnings.mapped_rule: Must Apply to Extend Study Permit Before It Expires
soft_warnings.message: Apply to extend at least 30 days before expiry to keep maintained status.

soft_warnings.mapped_rule: Spousal Open Work Permit Now Restricted to Masters (16+ Months) and Doctoral Students
soft_warnings.message: From Jan 2025, spousal OWPs are limited mainly to spouses of Masters (16+ months)/doctoral and select students. Undergrad/college spouses are generally ineligible.

soft_warnings.mapped_rule: PGWP Requires PGWP-Eligible DLI and Qualifying Field of Study (Non-Degree Programs)
soft_warnings.message: Confirm PGWP eligibility before enrolling. Some programs/DLIs do not qualify — a common trap sold by agents.

soft_warnings.mapped_rule: PGWP Requires PGWP-Eligible DLI and Qualifying Field of Study (Non-Degree Programs)
soft_warnings.message: Non-degree (college diploma) PGWP eligibility is now tied to fields linked to labour shortages. Verify your program's field.
Prefer institution-authorised reps or an ICCRC/CICC-regulated consultant. 'Guaranteed visa' middlemen cause most fraud-related refusals.
